Ethereum Layer 2 network Blast announced in an X post on October 2 that it would gradually cease operations. The project said that when it was launched, its goal was to build a self-sustaining chain for users and developers, but that the maintenance costs have exceeded L2 revenue. It said it could not see a credible path to make the chain’s economics sustainable. The current priority is to ensure a smooth shutdown, and it asks users to withdraw all their assets (including Blast PWA balances) back to $ETH  mainnet.

In terms of the process, Blast first reduced the withdrawal delay to 24 hours and will exit its Lido holdings in advance, which is expected to take about a week. During this period, withdrawals will be temporarily unavailable. Once completed, withdrawals will resume with the new 24-hour delay. Users must withdraw via the normal interface before October 26, 2026. After that date, assets can still be withdrawn, but users will need to interact directly with Blast’s cross-chain bridge contract on Ethereum L1. The official side will publish detailed instructions by that time.

Public data shows that locked assets have fallen by roughly 98% from the peak in June 2024—down from more than $200 million to around $32 million. On-chain fee revenue over the past few months has also contracted sharply from its peak. Before the mainnet launch, large deposits were attracted due to expectations of native yield and point incentives, initiated by Blur founder Pacman and supported by firms including Paradigm. $BLAST fell noticeably for a time after the announcement.

#ETH #BLAST #Layer2  does not constitute investment advice

content:
以太坊二层网络 Blast 于10月2日在 X 发文宣布将逐步停止运营。项目称启动时目标是为用户与开发者构建自给自足的链，但维护成本已超过 L2 收入，看不到使链经济可持续的可信路径，当前优先保证关停平稳，要求用户将资产（含 Blast PWA 余额）全部提回 $ETH 主网。

流程上，Blast 先把提款延迟降至24小时，并先行退出其 Lido 资产，预计约一周，期间提款暂时不可用；完成后按新的24小时延迟恢复。用户须在2026年10月26日前通过正常界面提款；此后资产仍可提取，但需直接与以太坊 L1 上的 Blast 跨链桥合约交互，官方将于该日前发布详细说明。

公开数据显示，锁仓较2024年6月峰值逾20亿美元已回落约98%，目前约3200万美元量级；近月链上费用收入亦较高峰大幅收缩。主网上线前曾因原生收益与积分预期吸引大量存款，由 Blur 创始人 Pacman 发起并获 Paradigm 等支持。$BLAST 在公告后一度明显下跌。

As of 12:00 noon Beijing time on October 3, Ethereum is quoted at $2,673, down about 2.2% over the past 24 hours. Early this week, the price briefly surged to $2,755 on U.S. employment data strength. After reaching the upper Bollinger Band, it met with strong selling pressure and then quickly pulled back to around $2,670.

From the hourly K-line structure, Ethereum has been consolidating in a narrow range between $2,670 and $2,680. The major resistance levels are concentrated near the $2,700 round-number mark and around $2,701, close to the 25-day moving average. Support is located at the lower Bollinger Band around $2,631 and at the prior swing low near $2,672. Price is trading below all major moving averages, and the short-term bearish setup is clearly evident.

In the spot market, Ethereum has seen net outflows exceeding $240 million, indicating heavy selling pressure. More worrying, spot ETFs have ended the previous streak of consecutive net inflows and have flipped to net outflows of between $55.4 million and $173.0 million. Institutional buying has temporarily stepped aside, adding further pressure on the price in the near term.

II. Interpretation of Technical Indicators

The moving-average system shows a clear bearish arrangement. The current price of $2,673 is far below the 7-day moving average at $2,676, the 25-day moving average at $2,701, and the 99-day moving average at $2,695. These three moving averages are pressing down on the price from top to bottom. In the short term, the price needs to reclaim the $2,700 level effectively to reverse the weak trend. EMA7 has crossed below EMA25 to form a “dead cross,” further confirming the short-term downward momentum.

The MACD indicator shows the DIFF line at -10.10, the DEA line at -9.54, and the histogram at -0.56. Although MACD is still running below the zero axis, the negative histogram value is steadily shrinking—down from -3.83 to -0.56—indicating that bearish momentum is rapidly weakening. If MACD can complete a golden cross while still below the zero axis, it would confirm a technical rebound signal.

For the RSI indicator, the 6-period RSI is 40.62, the 12-period RSI is 40.23, and the 24-period RSI is 44.21. RSI across all periods is in a neutral-to-weak region; it has not yet entered oversold territory, but the downside room appears relatively limited. In the KDJ indicator, K is 64.95, D is 56.30, and J is 82.26. After falling back from the overbought region, the three lines have stabilized, suggesting that near-term correction pressure has largely been released.

For the Bollinger Bands, the upper band is at $2,752, the middle band at $2,692, and the lower band at $2,632. Price is trading below the middle band, and the band width has narrowed. ATR has fallen from 17.30 to 14.47, meaning volatility is decreasing; the market is accumulating energy while waiting for direction selection. The Williams indicator has risen from -75.69 to -55.33, showing that an oversold condition is being repaired.

III. Market Sentiment Analysis

Based on technical-factor statistics, among the 15 factors for Ethereum, 10 are issuing buy (long) signals and 5 are issuing sell (short) signals. The long signal proportion is 66.7%. With the combined indicators issuing buy signals, the historical win rate is 100%. Despite being a small-sample setup, it is extremely strong, implying that the current technical picture has a strong expectation for a rebound.

However, Ethereum faces some unique structural pressures. The number of validators exiting the queue has exceeded 818,000 ETH, with an average waiting time of about 14.8 days. Ongoing de-queued / unstaking pressure creates potential mid-to-long-term selling pressure on price. Additionally, Blast, Ethereum’s Layer 2 network, announced it is shutting down. The news that operating costs exceed revenue has also shaken market confidence in Ethereum ecosystem expansion.

That said, looking at the mid-to-long term, positive factors should not be ignored. The SEC’s approval of a 3x leveraged Ethereum ETF brings new channels for institutional investors. The tokenized real-world asset (RWA) scale has reached $34.5 billion, up 140% year over year. Ethereum’s leading position as a smart contract platform remains solid. As the regulatory environment continues to improve and institutional participation increases, Ethereum’s mid-to-long-term value is still worth expecting.

Among popular tokens, SAND is currently quoted at $0.0834, with a 24-hour increase of 80.03%, leading the market. MANA is quoted at $0.1120, up 24.72%, and the metaverse sector is collectively strengthening. NIGHT is quoted at $0.0500, up 24.51%, indicating that capital is searching for new hot directions.

以太坊市场深度分析：多重压力叠加技术面修复，关注关键支撑位得失

一、价格走势分析

截至北京时间十月三日中午十二点，以太坊报价两千六百七十三美元，过去二十四小时下跌约百分之二点二。价格在本周初受美国就业数据利好一度冲高至两千七百五十五美元，触及布林带上轨后遭遇强烈抛压，随后快速回落至两千六百七十美元附近。

从小时K线结构来看，以太坊在两千六百七十至两千六百八十美元区间内窄幅震荡，上方阻力位集中在两千七百美元整数关口和二十五日均线两千七百零一美元附近。下方支撑位位于两千六百三十一美元的布林带下轨，以及两千六百七十二美元的前期低点。价格运行在所有主要均线下方，短期弱势格局明显。

现货市场方面，以太坊经历了超过两亿四千万美元的资金净流出，卖压显著。更令人担忧的是，现货ETF结束了此前的连续净流入态势，转为净流出五千五百四十万至一千七百三十万美元，机构买盘暂时退场，这对短期价格形成了额外压制。

二、技术指标解读

均线系统呈现明显的空头排列。当前价格两千六百七十三美元远低于七日均线两千六百七十六美元、二十五日均线两千七百零一美元和九十九日均线两千六百九十五美元。三条均线自上而下压制价格，短期内价格需要有效收复两千七百美元才能扭转弱势格局。EMA七已下穿EMA二十五形成死叉，进一步确认了短期下行趋势。

MACD指标显示，DIFF线位于负十点一零，DEA线位于负九点五四，柱状图为负零点五六。MACD虽然仍在零轴下方运行，但柱状图负值持续收窄，从负三点八三逐步缩小至负零点五六，空头动能正在快速衰减。若MACD能在零轴下方完成金叉，将确认技术性反弹信号。

RSI指标方面，六周期RSI为四十点六二，十二周期RSI为四十点二三，二十四周期RSI为四十四点二一。各周期RSI均处于中性偏弱区域，尚未进入超卖区间，但下行空间已较为有限。KDJ指标中K值为六十四点九五，D值为五十六点三零，J值为八十二点二六，三线从超买区域回落后企稳，短期调整压力基本释放。

布林带方面，上轨两千七百五十二美元，中轨两千六百九十二美元，下轨两千六百三十二美元。价格在中轨下方运行，带宽有所收窄。ATR从十七点三零下降至十四点四七，波动率降低，市场正在积蓄能量等待方向选择。威廉指标从负七十五点六九回升至负五十五点三三，显示超卖状态正在修复。

三、市场情绪分析

从技术因子统计来看，以太坊的十五个因子中同样有十个发出做多信号，五个发出做空信号，做多占比百分之六十六点七。综合指标发出做多信号，历史胜率为百分之百，在小样本下表现极为强势，暗示当前技术面存在较强的反弹预期。

然而，以太坊面临一些特有的结构性压力。验证者退出队列已超过八十一万八千枚以太坊，等待时间约为十四点八天，持续的解质押压力对价格构成了中长期的潜在抛压。此外，以太坊二层网络Blast宣布关闭，运营成本超过收入的消息也打击了市场对以太坊生态扩张的信心。

不过从中长期来看，利好因素同样不容忽视。SEC批准三倍杠杆以太坊ETF为市场带来了新的机构投资者入场渠道，代币化现实世界资产规模已达三百四十五亿美元，同比增长百分之一百四十，以太坊作为智能合约平台的龙头地位依然稳固。随着监管环境持续改善和机构参与度提升，以太坊的中长期价值依然值得期待。

热门代币方面，SAND当前报价零点零八三四美元，二十四小时涨幅达百分之八十点零三，领跑市场。MANA报价零点一一二零美元，涨幅百分之二十四点七二，元宇宙板块集体走强。NIGHT报价零点零五零零美元，涨幅百分之二十四点五一，显示出资金正在寻找新的热点方向。

#Ethereum #ETH #加密市场

🟢 第二目标：2780

昨天的实际结果：
✅ BTC到达第一目标86900
✅ ETH到达第一目标2750
两笔策略都实现盈利。
但是交易不能一直活在昨天。昨日策略完成后，今天必须根据新的盘面结构重新判断。

二、BTC今日行情分析
截至中午12点30分，BTC在84530附近，过去24小时最高87220、最低83888，跌幅约2.6%。
目前BTC一小时价格已经跌破MA20和MA50，一小时RSI降至24附近，说明短线空头占据主动，但当前位置也已经接近超卖。

因此，今天的判断很明确：
⚠️ 短线已经转弱，但当前位置不追空，等待价格反弹至压力区域。
BTC今日关键位置：
🔴 短线压力：85000—85300
🔴 强压力：85600
🔵 第一支撑：84200
🔵 第二支撑：83900
BTC今日策略
等待BTC反弹至：
🟠 85000—85300：空单观察区域
如果反弹无法站稳85300，随后重新跌回85000下方，可以观察空单机会。
🔴 失效位置：85700上方
🟢 第一目标：84300
🟢 第二目标：83900
如果BTC直接跌破：
❌ 83900
不要在低位追空。
可以等待价格反抽84200附近。如果反抽后仍然无法站回，再考虑顺势跟随。
相反，如果BTC重新站稳：
❌ 85300
并且回踩85000不破，今天的空单计划取消。
这种情况下，价格可能重新测试：
🟡 85800—86200

三、ETH今日行情分析
截至发稿前，ETH在2674附近，过去24小时最高2777、最低2651，跌幅约2.6%。
ETH已经跌破一小时MA20和MA50，一小时RSI在30附近，短线结构同样偏弱。

🔴 压力区域：2695—2710
🔵 第一支撑：2650
🔵 第二支撑：2635

等待ETH反弹至：

❌ 2710
今天的空单思路暂时取消，重新观察盘面结构。

四、弱非农为何没有让BTC继续上涨？
昨天公布的美国9月份非农就业数据为：
📉 新增非农就业：2.9万人
📊 失业率：升至4.2%
📉 7月和8月就业数据：合计下修6万人
新增就业明显低于市场预期。数据公布后，美债收益率回落，市场对美联储继续加息的预期有所降温，BTC一度冲上87200附近。
但是BTC没有站稳高位，随后又将涨幅全部吐回。
这说明市场目前存在两种相反的逻辑：
就业数据偏弱，有利于缓解加息压力就业放缓过于明显，也会增加市场对经济走弱的担忧
再加上87200附近本身存在获利盘和卖压，最终形成了冲高回落。
所以今天不能简单理解为“非农偏弱就一定利多”。
真正需要观察的，是价格能否重新站回关键压力位。

₿ BTC
🔵 下方支撑：83900
🔴 上方压力：85300
◆ ETH
🔵 下方支撑：2650
🔴 上方压力：2710
BTC没有站回85300、ETH没有站回2710之前，日内以观察反弹后的承压表现为主。
但当前位置已经接近短线超卖区域，所以今天的核心策略是：
不在低位追空，等待反弹至压力区域，再根据承压信号执行。#BTC #ETH

BTC 84537 is turning uniformly green across the board, yet the funding rate is flat: this leg is spot selling, not a leverage domino

At midday, the market trend is a neat shade of green. BTC 84537.5 is down 2.34%; ETH 2674.61 is down 2.38%; XRP 1.4851 is down 2.94%—the worst performer; BNB 767.28 is down 1.86%, a drop that’s “well-mannered.”

What’s really worth noting is the funding rate. BTC’s rate is only 0.00146%, while ETH has even slipped into negative. Translate it plainly: this selloff wasn’t triggered by a cascade of leveraged liquidations—it’s spot markets selling with real money. Pumping washes need leverage to cooperate; dumping doesn’t. The follow-through from these two situations can be worlds apart.

Just a few days ago, people were shouting for new highs; today they’ve all switched their tune to “a healthy pullback.” Down 2.34% is called healthy—if it falls further, it becomes a “golden pit.” The script always runs ahead of price action. When they were shouting, their voices were the loudest; when it’s time to admit fault, they all collectively forget.

The market structure also looks ugly. BTC is stuck between the 24-hour low of 83841.9 and the daily buy point 83133.27, with the daily axis point 85191.43 pressing down overhead. Even the rebound doesn’t manage to touch the edge of the chain rebound point—this suggests weak buy-side strength. The short signal is clear: if it can’t reclaim 85191.43, then treat any rebound as merely a window for locking in profits. Until the daily selling point 86540.97 is established above, don’t talk to people about a reversal.

ETH is weaker. ETH at 2674.61 has long lost the axis point 2698.06. The 24-hour low at 2647.9 is basically meaningless now—the real support to watch is the daily buy point 2617.12.

From the chart, price has been grinding back and forth within a range for this period, repeatedly washing out the market. Bulls and bears are in a tug-of-war here. For those who are not firmly committed, the whipsaws keep sweeping their stops and forcing them out.

The 2785 area is currently the most critical resistance level. My personal view is that only with an effective breakout above 2785 on convincing volume will this ETH uptrend truly open up room. Once it breaks and holds, there won’t be strong overhead pressure to block the way, and price should continue moving higher along the trend.

On the fundamentals, spot ETF inflows have been ongoing. Institutional capital has been gradually building positions, and “whale” addresses have not dumped large amounts into exchanges. The logic of long-term holders locking up their supply is still intact. On the macro side, liquidity expectations provide support for the broader market; it’s not a one-time short-term hype.

In terms of technical structure, the daily timeframe shows a rising bottom: higher lows keep forming, which is a typical bullish “accumulation/building energy” pattern. The current consolidation is just a form of整理 (consolidation) during an upswing—it is not a reversal into a decline. Even if there is a short-term pullback, it may still be an opportunity for bulls to get onboard. The key is to hold the main support; the larger bullish trend won’t easily change.

Of course, the market won’t move in a straight line. Before the breakout and hold above 2800, the range-bound washout may continue—don’t chase prices higher. Only after the market truly confirms and holds above 2800 should you then follow the trend to look toward the upside targets.

Second, beyond the market itself, I’ve learned a bit about Qimen Dunjia and the Liu Ren divination system. In the Qimen course, the Kun palace is situated over the 9th ground (九地), with a Ji + Wu setup. The “9th ground” signifies calm steadiness—slow progress due to time and accumulation. If I apply this to interpreting the price action, it could be a grind, with震荡 (choppy consolidation). With Ji + Wu, the advantage is chasing profit but expect setbacks—there’s little chance of a one-way “straight flight.” There will definitely be pullbacks!

This lesson corresponds to an “Yin escape” (阴遁) 7 bureau (局), with Jia Shen xu nian at noon (甲申旬午未空). Kun belongs to 未, while 午未 is “empty” (未空). The “wealth star” (财星) is in a state of emptiness and won’t really exert power until it is filled. The current value sign (值符) generates wealth in the wealth palace, meaning there isn’t momentum for a market-wide collapse and big drop in the broader environment. Meanwhile, the value officer (值使) overcomes the “dead gate” (死门) against wealth, which suppresses short-term pullbacks. Opportunities may come on 10.11, the Wu day (戊午). The main peak may be on 10.12, the Ji-Wei day (己未). Each day around the 午 and 未 hours (noon and pre-afternoon) is more likely to see upside spurts.

基本面这边，现货ETF资金持续有流入，机构资金一直在慢慢布局，巨鲸地址的筹码也没有大批量砸向交易所，长期筹码锁仓的逻辑还在。宏观层面，流动性预期对大盘是支撑，不是短期一次性炒作。

技术结构上，日线级别底部抬升，低点不断抬高，属于典型多头蓄力形态。现在的震荡，就是上涨途中的整理，不是反转下跌。短线就算有回踩，也是给多头上车的机会，关键支撑守住，大的多头趋势不会轻易改变。

当然行情不会一蹴而就，突破2800之前，震荡洗盘还会持续，不要追高。真正确认突破站稳2800之后，再顺势去看上方目标。

其次在说一些行情之外的东西，本人对奇门遁甲及大六壬略有学习。从奇门课来看坤宫临九地，己 + 戊格局。九地主沉稳，慢在于时间的积累。如果我运用到行情的解读，可能是磨盘，震荡！己 + 戊，优势求财波折，单边起飞可能性很小，必有回踩！本课阴遁 7 局，甲申旬午未空。坤属未，午未空，财星空亡，要等填实才会发力。值符生财宫，大环境没有崩盘大跌的动能；值使死门克财，短线有回调压制。机会可能在10.11 戊午日，主高点在 10.12 己未日，每日午时、未时容易冲高。

Need to clarify the metric boundaries: this ranking tracks the platform users’ search behavior over the past 24 hours. It is a measure of attention, not a buy action or net capital inflow, and it does not constitute a prediction of price direction. In other words, it answers which assets are being searched frequently, rather than which ones are being massively bought. The large gap between the #1 search ranking and the #916 market cap ranking indicates a clear mismatch between attention heat and the asset’s existing supply size. This mismatch can serve as an entry point for observing attention fluctuations in small-cap assets.

At the same time, multiple pieces of information remain unknown: this snapshot has no prior data for comparison, so it is impossible to determine whether the ranking is rising, staying flat, or falling. There is no event-type evidence at present, so attention cannot be linked to specific news such as project operations, partnerships, or listings. Whether search popularity can translate into sustained trading demand is not verifiable with available data. Moreover, the snapshot itself does not provide the regions of the search sources or the user composition.

Three points to watch next: first, whether M87 can maintain a position near the top of the ranking across the next several snapshots, to distinguish temporary attention from sustained attention; second, whether the project’s official channels provide explanations that match the level of attention; third, whether indicators such as liquidity and market depth change accordingly. If the range hasn’t broken, keep buying back and forth—don’t be greedy

After the Non-Farm Payroll report came out unexpectedly cold, everyone sang “buy” across the board. Bitcoin surged to 87,000 and Ethereum climbed to 2,777. At the time, what I reminded was: “good news already priced in is no longer good—watch out for geopolitical risk and oil prices.” Then in the middle of the night, the situation in the Middle East escalated and oil prices suddenly dropped. BTC fell from 87,000 to 83,000, and ETH from 2,800 to 2,650.

I was short at 2,745 on ETH. I took partial profits in batches around 2,690 and caught a move. After the drop, I assessed: geopolitics is only temporary— it didn’t break the range of consolidation. BTC’s support at the lower edge of 83,000 to 87,000 is strong, and ETH’s support at 2,650 to 2,800 is equally strong. As long as the range isn’t broken, it’s still range trading—so I flipped and went long.

The logic is very clear—short the highs as the main approach, and only go long at the lows with a light position. Around the upper edges of 87,000 and 2,800, you still need to short. Around the lower edges of 83,000 and 2,650, you can take longs with a small size. In a range, you buy and sell back and forth: take the profit and run. If you’re not losing, you’re winning.

Ethereum Market In-Depth Analysis: Technical Repairs Under Multiple Pressures and Outlook for the Future

1. Price Trend Analysis

As of Beijing time on October 3, 2026, Ethereum is quoted at $2,684, down about 2.3% over the past 24 hours. Similar to Bitcoin, Ethereum has also been affected by U.S. non-farm payroll data, experiencing a pattern of rising first and then falling. In the early moments after the data release, Ethereum briefly followed the broader market higher. However, it was hit by a double blow: Blast’s announcement that it would shut down the Layer-2 network and consecutive days of net outflows from spot ETFs, causing the price to dip as low as $2,661.

From the candlestick data, over the past five one-hour intervals, Ethereum has shown a mild upward trend, rising gradually from $2,677 to $2,684. Each cycle closed with a small bullish candle. Regarding trading volume, the third cycle saw a surge to $12.81 million, then gradually fell back to $5.01 million, indicating that rebound momentum is weakening. The current price is trading above the Bollinger Band midline around $2,679. The upper band at $2,701 forms short-term resistance, while the lower band at $2,656 provides support. The Bollinger Bands continue to narrow and volatility has fallen to a low level, suggesting the market is accumulating energy and waiting for a breakout.

2. Interpretation of Technical Indicators

Moving average system: Ethereum is facing clear bearish pressure. The 7-period moving average is $2,681, below the 25-period moving average at $2,693 and the 99-period moving average at $2,696—forming a typical bearish alignment. The exponential moving averages show the same situation: the 7-period EMA is $2,681, the 25-period EMA is $2,688, and the 99-period EMA is $2,694. Although price has risen above the 7-period EMA, it is still constrained by the 25- and 99-period EMAs.

MACD shows a positive signal. The MACD line is -6.77, the signal line is -8.47, and the histogram is +1.70. Notably, the MACD histogram has been rising for three consecutive cycles, increasing from -0.36 to +1.70. This forms a confirmation of a golden cross after a bottom bearish divergence, which is an important technical signal for a short-term rebound. If the histogram continues to expand, the MACD line may cross above the signal line to form a standard golden cross.

RSI indicates short-term strength. The 6-period RSI is 59.85, having rebounded from the oversold region back to a neutral-to-strong position. The 12-period RSI is 47.67 and the 24-period RSI is 47.19, meaning the medium- to long-term RSI remains in the neutral range. This suggests the current rebound is still in its early stage. In the KDJ indicator, the K value is 81.92, the D value is 75.26, and the J value is 95.25. All three lines are in the high zone, implying a need for a short-term pullback.

The random RSI is at 100, already touching an extreme area—clearly signaling short-term overbought conditions. The Williams %R (WR) is -8.36, also in the overbought zone. The Parabolic SAR is at $2,653, far below the current price, maintaining a bullish signal. The Super Trend line is at $2,715, above the current price, creating overhead pressure. ATR is $12.29, with volatility continuing to decline. OBV rose from 404,221 to 418,161, showing that volume/flow is being accumulated continuously and providing a foundation for the next upward move.

3. Market Sentiment Analysis

Based on quantitative factor statistics, Ethereum’s long/short positioning is completely different from Bitcoin. Out of 15 factors, 11 send bullish (long) signals and only 3 send bearish (short) signals. The long ratio is as high as 73.33%, indicating the technical picture is more bullish in the medium to short term. However, the overall indicator currently also emits a bearish signal, and the historical win rate is 57.89%, suggesting that investors should remain cautious until the composite signals clearly shift.

On the news front, Ethereum faces multiple pressures. Blast’s Layer-2 network has announced a shutdown. Over the last 24 hours, on-chain revenue was only $110. From the peak of $2.27 billion in TVL, it has fallen sharply, severely undermining market confidence in Ethereum’s ecosystem. The number of validators exiting the queue has reached an annual high, with more than 818,000 ETH queued to withdraw/exit. The expected unlock period is about 14.7 days, creating a significant potential sell-pressure overhang. U.S. spot Ethereum ETFs have recorded net outflows for multiple consecutive days; daily outflows were $55.40 million and $17.30 million respectively, and institutional capital has temporarily chosen to wait and see.

That said, positive factors should not be ignored either. The U.S. SEC approved a 3x leveraged Ethereum ETF. While the short-term impact may be limited, it opens the door to more innovation in derivatives in the future. content:
以太坊市场深度解析：多重压力下的技术修复与后市展望

一、价格走势分析

北京时间2026年10月3日，以太坊报价2684美元，过去24小时下跌约2.3%。与比特币类似，以太坊同样受到美国非农就业数据的影响，经历了先涨后跌的走势。在数据公布初期，以太坊一度跟随大盘上行，但随后受到二层网络Blast宣布关闭以及现货ETF连续多日净流出的双重打击，价格一度下探至2661美元。

从K线数据来看，过去五个一小时周期以太坊呈现温和上涨态势，从2677美元逐步攀升至2684美元，每个周期均收出小阳线。成交量方面，第三个周期放量为1281万美元，随后逐步回落至501万美元，显示反弹动能正在减弱。当前价格运行在布林带中轨2679美元上方，上轨2701美元形成短线阻力，下轨2656美元提供支撑。布林带持续收窄，波动率降至低位，市场正在积蓄能量等待突破。

二、技术指标解读

均线系统方面，以太坊面临明显的空头压制。7周期均线2681美元低于25周期均线2693美元和99周期均线2696美元，典型的空头排列格局。指数均线同样如此，7周期EMA为2681美元，25周期EMA为2688美元，99周期EMA为2694美元，价格虽然站上7周期EMA，但仍受到25和99周期EMA的压制。

MACD指标出现积极信号。MACD线为负6.77，信号线为负8.47，柱状图为正1.70。值得注意的是，MACD柱状图已经连续三个周期走高，从负0.36上升至正1.70，形成底背离后的金叉确认，这是短线反弹的重要技术信号。若柱状图继续扩大，MACD线有望上穿信号线形成标准金叉。

RSI指标显示短线走强。6周期RSI达到59.85，已经从超卖区域回升至中性偏强位置。12周期RSI为47.67，24周期RSI为47.19，中长期RSI仍在中性区域，说明本轮反弹尚处于初期阶段。KDJ指标中K值为81.92，D值为75.26，J值为95.25，三线均处于高位区域，短线存在回调需求。

随机RSI达到100，已经触及极值区域，这是短线超买的明确信号。威廉指标WR为负8.36，同样处于超买区域。抛物线SAR位于2653美元，远低于当前价格，维持做多信号。超级趋势线位于2715美元，高于当前价格，形成上方压力。ATR为12.29美元，波动率持续下降。OBV指标从404221上升至418161，量能持续积累，为后续上涨提供了基础。

三、市场情绪分析

从量化因子统计来看，以太坊的多空格局与比特币截然不同。15个因子中有11个发出做多信号，仅3个发出做空信号，做多比例高达73.33%，显示中短线技术面偏多。但综合指标当前发出做空信号，历史胜率为57.89%，提示在综合信号转向之前仍需保持谨慎。

消息面上，以太坊面临多重压力。Blast二层网络宣布关闭，最后24小时链上收入仅110美元，从峰值22.7亿美元TVL跌落，严重打击了市场对以太坊生态的信心。验证者退出队列达到年度高峰，超过81.8万枚以太坊排队等待退出，预计解锁时间约14.7天，形成了显著的潜在抛压。美国现货以太坊ETF连续多日净流出，单日流出分别达到5540万美元和1730万美元，机构资金暂时选择观望。

不过利好因素同样不容忽视。美国SEC批准了3倍杠杆以太坊ETF，虽然短期影响有限，但为未来更多衍生品创新打开了大门。从长期来看，以太坊生态依然是去中心化金融的核心基础设施，Blast的退出反而可能促使资金流向更优质的二层网络项目。

总体而言，以太坊短线技术面出现修复信号，MACD柱状图转正和OBV持续上升都是积极迹象。但验证者解锁抛压和ETF流出仍是悬在头顶的达摩克利斯之剑。建议投资者关注2656美元支撑和2701美元阻力，在确认突破方向后顺势操作。

MetaMask disclosed a base infrastructure security incident on September 30 and took preventive measures, starting to wind down its non-custodial staking business (MetaMask Staking, formerly Consensys Staking) that operates Ethereum validators on the Lido protocol. The company said it has not found any direct threats to MetaMask wallets at present. This staking uses a non-custodial architecture; the platform does not hold users’ withdrawal keys. Validator daily signing and withdrawal destinations are handled by different credentials. The Lido research forum also clarified at the same time: $stETH holders do not need to take any further action.

In terms of the process, the relevant validators have already initiated their exit. The final batch is expected to complete the exit by October 7, 2026 (at which point not all withdrawals will yet be completed). Because Ethereum has a long queue, the full cycle of exit, withdrawal, and re-entry could last up to about 45 days. During this period, users may miss rewards. If validators are taken offline early to reduce the risk of network penalties, they may also incur slashing penalties. On-chain research estimates that around 17,000 validators—totaling about 523,000 $ETH —are in the exit queue, and that about 0.36 ETH in block production rewards were previously directed to an abnormal address. MetaMask has not yet publicly confirmed the above scale and the intrusion path. The investigation is ongoing, and users are reminded to watch for potential phishing risks going forward.

MetaMask's Parent Company Is Finally Heading to Wall Street

Consensys — the company behind MetaMask and Infura, two tools basically every $ETH  user has touched — is targeting a fall 2026 IPO after multiple delays, with JPMorgan and Goldman Sachs leading the offering.

The backstory makes this interesting: Consensys was last valued at $7 billion back in 2022. Reports now suggest the IPO could target $10 billion or more. But getting here wasn't smooth — the SEC had an active complaint against Consensys over MetaMask staking services, and a crypto market slump earlier this year forced the company to push its original February timeline all the way to fall.

Why this one matters more than a typical listing:

This would be the first major IPO from a company this deeply embedded in Ethereum's core infrastructure. MetaMask alone has over 30 million users, and Infura quietly powers a huge chunk of apps built on Ethereum behind the scenes.

The honest uncertainty here: a $7B private valuation from 2022 doesn't automatically mean the public market agrees in 2026. BitGo's rocky public debut earlier this year is already being cited as a cautionary example for crypto IPOs that overpromise on valuation.

If Consensys prices well, it becomes the benchmark for how public markets actually value Ethereum infrastructure, not just the token itself.

Does MetaMask's massive user base justify a $10B+ valuation, or is that pricing in too much optimism? 👇

October Ethereum Market Panorama Analysis: Opportunities Amid Short-Term Pressure and Ecological Changes

I. Price Trend Analysis

As of the afternoon of October 3rd Beijing time, Ethereum is quoted at $2,682. Over the past 24 hours, it has fallen by about 2.1%, with the decline slightly larger than Bitcoin’s. In recent hours, price has been fluctuating narrowly around $2,680. The range of the latest five 1-hour candlesticks is only about $10, indicating the market is in an extremely low-volume, wait-and-see state. Intraday, the high reached $2,683 and the low hit $2,672, and overall it shows a weak consolidation pattern.

At the beginning of this month, Ethereum was also boosted by favorable U.S. employment data. However, the rebound strength was clearly weaker than Bitcoin’s. Spot net outflows from exchanges exceed $240 million, and large sell orders cluster around the release of macro data. In addition, Ethereum ETFs have continued to see redemptions for multiple days: the single-day redemption size ranges from $17.3 million to $55.4 million, highlighting significant pressure on liquidity. Moreover, the staking exit queue has surged to more than 818,000 ETH, with the waiting time extended to about 14.8 days. This implies that a large amount of staked tokens may still enter the market in the future, potentially creating sell pressure.

II. Technical Indicator Interpretation

In terms of moving averages, the 7-day moving average at $2,679 is below the 25-day moving average at $2,695 and the 99-day moving average at $2,695. Short-, mid-, and long-term moving averages are all suppressing price, and the bearish alignment is clear. The exponential moving average (EMA) system shows a similar picture: the 7-day EMA at $2,680 is far below the 25-day EMA at $2,688 and the 99-day EMA at $2,693. Notably, the current price has already fallen below all major moving averages, making the technical outlook clearly weak.

The Bollinger Bands indicator shows the upper band at $2,718, the middle band at $2,681, and the lower band at $2,645. Price is hovering near the middle band, while the Bollinger Band width is contracting, suggesting an upcoming directional breakout. For MACD, the DIF line is at -7.71, the DEA line at -8.92, and the histogram is at +1.21. Although the MACD main line is still below the zero axis, the histogram has turned positive for three consecutive periods and continues to expand. This indicates that short-term bearish momentum is weakening, with early signs of a bottoming-and-rebound setup.

RSI’s 6-period value has risen to 53.7, returning to a neutral-to-slightly bullish area. The 12-period RSI at 45.3 remains in the neutral zone. The KDJ indicator looks relatively strong: K is 78.9, D is 71, and J is 94.6. The J line has entered a high zone, implying short-term downside pullback risk. The Williams indicator has rebounded quickly from -59 to -11.0 as well, which also reflects a short-term overbought condition. The stochastic RSI has reached an extreme high around 99, signaling that the price may face technical pullback pressure in the near term.

III. Market Sentiment Analysis

According to trading factor statistics, among 15 factors, 10 send bullish signals, 4 send bearish signals, and 1 is neutral. The proportion of bullish factors is as high as 66.7%, clearly better than Bitcoin’s factor structure. However, composite indicators show a bearish signal, with an overall win rate of 60.53%. This divergence suggests that although most factors are leaning bullish, the key weighting factors still favor the bears, and the market direction remains unclear.

At the ecosystem level, major recent changes have emerged. Layer2 network Blast announced it is stopping operations. Its average daily on-chain revenue has fallen to just $110, far from covering operating costs. This stands in sharp contrast to the earlier peak TVL of $2.27 billion. The BLAST token dropped by about 19% immediately, prompting deep reflection in the market on whether an air-drop-driven Layer2 growth model is sustainable. On the other hand, the SEC has approved the listing of 3x leveraged Bitcoin and Ethereum ETFs. This milestone regulatory breakthrough may bring new speculative and institutional capital inflows to Ethereum.

From on-chain data, Ethereum’s main risks currently include: potential sell pressure from the continuously growing staking exit queue; the negative impact of Layer2 ecosystem contraction on overall on-chain activity; and the need for a pullback after short-term technical overbought conditions. But in the medium to long term, approval of 3x leveraged ETFs, progress on the SEC crypto custody framework, and continued improvement in the global regulatory environment all provide solid fundamental support for Ethereum. In the short term, Ethereum is expected to trade in a range of $2,630 to $2,720, waiting for direction to be chosen.

以太坊十月市场全景分析：短期承压与生态变革中的机遇

一、价格走势分析

截至北京时间十月三日下午，以太坊报价二千六百八十二美元，过去二十四小时下跌约百分之二点一，跌幅略大于比特币。价格在过去数小时内围绕二千六百八十美元窄幅波动，最近五根一小时K线的波动区间仅约十美元，显示市场处于极度缩量观望状态。日内最高触及二千六百八十三美元，最低二千六百七十二美元，整体呈现弱势整理格局。

以太坊在本月初同样受到美国就业数据利好的提振，但反弹力度明显弱于比特币。交易所现货净流出超过二亿四千万美元，大额卖单集中在宏观数据发布前后，叠加以太坊ETF连续多日出现赎回，单日赎回规模从一千七百三十万到五千五百四十万美元不等，资金面压力显著。此外，质押退出队列飙升至超过八十一万八千枚以太坊，等待时间延长至约十四点八天，意味着未来仍有大量质押代币可能进入市场形成抛压。

二、技术指标解读

均线系统方面，七日均线二千六百七十九美元低于二十五日均线二千六百九十五美元和九十九日均线二千六百九十五美元，短中长期均线全面压制价格，空头排列格局清晰。指数移动平均线同样呈现类似态势，七日EMA二千六百八十美元远低于二十五日EMA二千六百八十八美元和九十九日EMA二千六百九十三美元。值得注意的是，当前价格已跌破所有主要均线，技术面偏弱信号明确。

布林带指标显示上轨二千七百一十八美元，中轨二千六百八十一美元，下轨二千六百四十五美元。价格在中轨附近徘徊，布林带宽度正在收窄，预示即将迎来方向性突破。MACD指标方面，DIF线负七点七一，DEA线负八点九二，柱状图正一点二一，虽然MACD主线仍在零轴下方，但柱状图已连续三期转正且持续扩大，显示短期做空动能正在减弱，有筑底反弹的初步迹象。

RSI六周期回升至五十三点七，已回到中性偏强区域，RSI十二周期四十五点三仍处于中性区域。KDJ指标表现较为强势，K值七十八点九，D值七十一，J值九十四点六，J线已进入高位区域，短期存在回调风险。威廉指标从负五十九快速回升至负十一点零，同样显示短期超买状态。随机RSI指标已达九十九点七的极端高位，提示短期价格可能面临技术性回调压力。

三、市场情绪分析

从交易因子统计来看，十五个因子中十个发出做多信号，四个做空信号，一个中性，做多因子占比高达百分之六十六点七，明显优于比特币的因子结构。然而复合指标却显示为做空信号，整体胜率百分之六十点五三，这一背离说明虽然多数因子偏多，但关键权重因子仍偏向空头，市场方向尚不明朗。

生态层面近期出现重大变化。Layer2网络Blast宣布停止运营，其日均链上收入已降至仅一百一十美元，远无法覆盖运营成本，与此前二十二点七亿美元TVL的高峰形成鲜明对比。BLAST代币应声下跌约百分之十九，这一事件引发了市场对空投驱动型Layer2增长模式可持续性的深刻反思。不过另一方面，SEC批准了三倍杠杆比特币和以太坊ETF的上市，这一里程碑式的监管突破有望为以太坊带来新的投机性和机构性资金流入。

从链上数据来看，以太坊当前面临的主要风险包括：质押退出队列持续增长带来的潜在抛压、Layer2生态收缩对整体链上活跃度的负面影响，以及短期技术指标超买后的回调需求。但中长期来看，三倍杠杆ETF的获批、SEC加密托管框架的推进，以及全球监管环境的持续改善，都为以太坊提供了坚实的基本面支撑。短期预计以太坊将在二千六百三十至二千七百二十美元区间震荡，等待方向选择。

title: 持仓的人越多越危险
subTitle:
杠杆一开始大量叠加，市场几乎走同一个剧本：先堆仓，再找一根针，然后用爆仓把多余的倍数清掉。过去一年走了两次，现在堆到了第三次的门口。

Coinglass 10 月 3 日这张全市场顶栏：24 小时成交 $2113.4 亿，只比前一日多 0.81%。持仓 $1503.9 亿，少 2.22%。爆仓 $4.29 亿，多 37.48%。多空比 49.17% 对 50.83%。总市值大约 $2.88 万亿，持仓占市值大约 5.2%。成交还在，仓位开始撤，爆仓开始放大。剧本的第一页通常就是这样。

第一次是 2025 年 10 月。10 月 7 日，主要场所名义未平仓大约 $2359 亿，比特币期货未平仓站上 $900 亿，现货刚创过大约 $12.6 万。仓堆满以后，10 月 10 日到 11 日一根针下来，Coinglass 上报的 24 小时清算大约 $193 亿，约 160 万个账户，多单大约 $167 亿。永续未平仓从大约 $2170 亿掉到 $1230 亿，少了四成。做市商估计真实清算更高，因为交易所不是每笔都即时上报。到年底，持仓才回到大约 $1450 亿。

第二次是 2026 年 2 月。10 月清完，杠杆又叠回来。2 月 1 日凌晨失守支撑，BTC 下探大约 $75,720。AiCoin 记的是 12 小时上报爆仓约 $23.7 亿，多单约 $22.2 亿，空单约 $1.5 亿。当天的 24 小时口径有 $22 亿到 $25.6 亿几种报法，方向一致，九成以上是多单。后面几周比特币期货未平仓下降大约两成，价格从 8 万美元上方打到 6 万美元出头。没有交易所爆雷。清的就是这层仓。

清完又叠。9 月 21 日空头被挤，全市场持仓一天涨到大约 $1560 亿。10 月 3 日回到 $1504 亿，就在清算后的平台上沿。比特币永续大约 $361 亿，以太坊全网大约 $353 亿。账户几乎对半，大户持仓比大约 2，山寨账户比更偏多。10 月 1 日，跟踪市场里绝大多数仍是多头在付资金费。

三次不是同一个价，是同一个顺序。持仓先到高位，资金费率告诉你谁在付钱扛单，然后一根针打中拥挤的那一边，爆仓把未平仓打下去一截到四成。2025 年 10 月打的是多头，持仓掉四成。2026 年 2 月打的还是多头，持仓掉大约两成。9 月 21 日先打的是空头，所以持仓不降反升，燃料留到了现在。

眼下这一页已经翻开：持仓 24 小时少 2.22%，爆仓增 37%。这一步还小。前两次的清理，是单日爆仓从几亿抬到二十亿上下，持仓连续往下掉。掉到那个幅度之前，只能说燃料在，不能说哪一天点火。点火以后，拥挤的那一边要跑掉#BTC走势分析 #btc70k #永续 #套利新天地 #ETH

Most coins are down, and overall market sentiment is clearly not as good—but $UNI  actually managed to rise slightly against the trend, by about 1%.

In situations like this, you shouldn’t chase those coins that suddenly pump up.
Because what’s really worth watching is sometimes this kind of thing: when the broader market is weak, it just won’t move down.
A few days ago, when UNI pulled back from above $9, many people’s first reaction was: it’s already up, so it must be going to drop.
But looking at it now, $UNI  has slowly moved back into the $8–9 range.
Even more interesting, since the end of September, on-chain data shows that during the UNI retracement, some large holders have continued adding to their positions.

So when I look at UNI now, it’s not that I’m saying it’s so great just because it’s up 1% today.
What I care more about is: when the market starts heading downward, has UNI been directly abandoned and dumped by capital?
So far, it hasn’t!
And this kind of chart setup is the easiest to produce one scenario:
Everyone feels like it’s not very interesting, yet money is quietly picking it up little by little from below.
Then, when one day the whole market turns strong again, and UNI suddenly starts expanding volume, many people’s first reaction will be: “Damn it, why did it pump again?”
So right now, $UNI  in the high-$8 range is a very cost-effective price.

title: 成本不是成交后才出现
subTitle:
成本不是成交后才出现

BTC 昨晚冲到 86K 上方后又回到 84.6K 附近，很多交易者今天下午复盘时会盯着同一个问题：方向到底有没有看错。

但对合约交易来说，方向只是第一层。真正容易把利润磨薄的，往往不是图上那根 K 线，而是你按下按钮之前看不见的订单环境。

这两天的盘面很典型：波动变大，讨论变热，很多人看到价格从 84K 往上弹，就会默认“只要方向对，成交差一点也没关系”。问题是，成交差一点不是一个点，它会沿着整笔交易一路漂移。

第一层漂移来自报价层。

屏幕上看到的价格通常只是最靠前的一层报价。行情刚被消息推起来时，前两档看起来还在，但真实可吃的数量可能已经变薄。你以为自己是在同一个价位附近成交，实际目标数量往后吃了几层，成交均价就开始偏离。

这不是“手慢了”的问题，而是流动性在不同路径之间分散以后，同一时间、同一交易对、同一个方向，订单承接并不一致。

第二层漂移来自点差和深度。

很多人只看手续费，因为手续费是明牌。但更麻烦的是，点差和深度不是静态的。盘面越热，报价层越容易撤、越容易薄，尤其是周末或数据后这种情绪还在、流动性却不一定同步恢复的时段。

同样是追一笔 1,000 USDT 名义金额的订单，如果路径 A 前两档还算厚，路径 B 前两档已经空了一截，最后的执行成本可能完全不是一个级别。你看到的是“都成交了”，账户里体现的是“成本已经不一样了”。

第三层漂移来自规则和触发条件。

交易者最容易低估的是：成交不是结束，而是订单环境的一部分。不同路径对触发、标记价格、风控边界、退出承接的处理方式不一样。进场时差一点，退出时再差一点，中间再叠加费用和报价层变化，最后就会变成一笔你说不清从哪里漏掉的成本。

所以今天这种 86K 冲高后回到 84K 一带的行情，最不该只复盘“我有没有看对方向”。更应该复盘的是：我当时看到的成交价，和真实能拿到的成交质量是不是一回事？

这也是为什么合约交易越来越像路线选择，而不是单纯的按钮选择。

过去很多人习惯固定在一个地方下单，久了以后会把界面熟悉感当成确定性。但流动性一旦分散，熟悉不等于更便宜，快也不等于更稳。真正有价值的是在下单前先比较：哪条路径的点差更窄，哪边深度更能承接目标数量，费用结构和触发条件有没有隐藏差异，退出时会不会同样顺。

PerpEX 这类执行比较视角的意义，不是告诉你该押哪个方向，而是把“先选资产，再比较订单环境，最后决定这一单往哪走”变成一个更清醒的动作。

图表能帮你判断机会，订单环境决定你拿到的结果。行情越热，越不能只相信屏幕上的价格。

Costs don’t appear only after the trade fills

After BTC surged above 86K last night and then fell back to around 84.6K, many traders, during their afternoon recap today, will focus on the same question: did they misread the direction after all?

But for contract trading, direction is only the first layer. What often really erodes profit isn’t the single K-line shown in the chart, but the order environment you can’t see before you press the button.

The market over the past couple of days is very typical: volatility increases, discussions get heated, and many people, seeing the price bounce up from 84K, default to, “As long as the direction is right, it doesn’t matter if the fill is a bit worse.” The problem is that “a bit worse” isn’t just a point—it drifts across the entire trade from entry to completion.

Core Logic of Range Trading: When the price rises to the upper boundary of a recent range but fails to build volume and hold, it indicates insufficient bullish momentum. The price then pulls back into the range to continue oscillating; only when the lower boundary is not broken should you consider “buying the dip.”

Current price comparison: ETH 2681—yesterday’s attempt to break the range’s upper boundary wasn’t sustained, and price has returned to trading within the range. XRP 1.48—same pattern: it spiked and then fell back. It’s down 2.5% over the past 24 hours. The range’s upper boundary is a de-risking (cut/reduce) zone, so it’s not advisable to chase.

ADA current price 0.2445—still within a sideways structure. The support line that has been defended since mid-September is being tested again today. The 0.24 psychological round-number level can be viewed as a short-term defense line; only if it breaks should you talk about the trend weakening.#ADA #ETH

🤔 Why is South Korea’s Blockchain Week asking whether AI agents can master blockchain?

South Korea’s Blockchain Week recently threw out a bombshell question: can AI agents truly integrate seamlessly with blockchain systems? On the surface, it’s a technical discussion—but put plainly, they’re trying to figure out whether, if AI starts automatically conducting economic activities on-chain (e.g., automatically signing contracts and transferring funds), the existing blockchain architecture is hardcore enough. This is a make-or-break issue for the entire industry. Either the underlying infrastructure needs to be upgraded fast, or the industry risks being left behind.

At the heart of the debate is a revolution in how economic interactions work. Today, blockchain transactions require human confirmation, but if AI can directly operate, efficiency could jump by N times. Imagine if AI could automatically handle smart contract execution—the entire business logic would change. However, the biggest hurdle right now is that blockchain security and AI autonomy can’t peacefully coexist. AI might act recklessly for efficiency, but blockchain must be iron-fisted and impartial. That means the infrastructure has to be able to prevent AI from making mistakes, and the regulatory framework also needs to keep up. If AI starts going on-chain at scale and regulators don’t update, the whole ecosystem could freeze.

For the market, this may just be emotion-driven speculation in the short term. BTC and ETH have both been pulling back recently. With BTC at $119.56K and ETH at $2.68, if AI + blockchain really sparks a breakout, these two coins would likely be the first to punch through resistance levels. But more likely, this round of hype is just capital hunting for a new story—similar to how everyone was debating whether Web3 is actually worth anything not long ago. In the long run, this combination is a trend, but how things unfold depends on AI technological maturity and how tight or loose regulation is. If AI computing power suddenly surges, causing energy consumption to far exceed what blockchain can realistically handle, or if regulators suddenly issue a one-size-fits-all crackdown, then $119.56K and $2.68 might just be a dream.

💡 In short: AI + blockchain is the future, but the odds of short-term hype are high. If BTC can hold steady at $119.56K over the next two weeks, then the AI + blockchain story will truly heat up. But once it breaks below $83K, this logic will be up in the air. This article has no project sponsor involvement, and the author does not hold the assets mentioned in the article.

🤔 为什么韩国区块链周要问AI代理能否驾驭区块链？

韩国区块链周最近抛出一个炸弹级问题：AI代理到底能不能和区块链系统完美融合？表面看是技术探讨，说白了是想搞清楚，如果AI开始自动在链上搞经济活动（比如自动签合同、自动转账），现有的区块链架构够不够硬核。这对整个行业是生死问题——要么赶紧升级底层设施，要么就等着被淘汰。

这场讨论的核心是经济交互方式的革命。目前区块链交易得人工确认，但AI要是能直接操作，效率能提升N倍。想想看，如果AI能自动完成智能合约执行，那整个商业逻辑都要变。不过现在最大的坎在于，区块链的安全性和AI的自主性能不能和平共处。AI可能为了效率瞎操作，但区块链必须铁面无私。这意味着基础设施要能防住AI的误操作，监管框架也得跟上。如果AI开始大规模上链，监管不更新，那整个生态都得瘫痪。

An ETH stop-loss was triggered does not mean the position has already been closed.

At 14:44 Beijing time on October 3, 2026, we reviewed the Binance rules. The following is a hypothetical example for the $ETH /
USDT perpetual contract. The numbers are not the current support levels or trading advice.

Assume you place a sell stop-limit order. It triggers based on the latest executed price of the contract: trigger price 2660 USDT, sell limit price 2658 USDT.

If the latest executed price touches 2660, the order is triggered, but at that moment the highest bid in the order book has already jumped to 2645, and there is no higher buy order. This limit sell order will not fill at 2645; it needs to wait for a buy order that matches the limit price.

If the price continues to fall, “already triggered” cannot be treated as “already stopped out.” The position still carries price risk and liquidation risk.

For a stop-loss market order, once triggered it becomes a market instruction. It also cannot guarantee a fill at the trigger price, and sudden sharp drops may cause slippage.

To assess contract risk, besides looking at key price levels, you also need to consider the trigger-price convention, the order type, and the actual fill status.

前两天刚聊ETF资金狂飙27亿撑不起比特币，BlackRock旗下新基金IBIT一天就砸195.6百万美元进比特币，过去一个月总共买了1.57亿美元。这可不是小打小闹，相当于直接给监管认定的加密产品盖章，机构钱现在知道往哪儿走了。

为什么这条新闻重要？
这事根本原因在于BlackRock这次玩得不一样——他们不是在赌场玩比特币，是在正规金融产品里配置。IBIT是机构投资者能接触的合规通道，相当于美联储给加密资产开了个"白名单"。这意味着机构资金入场不是看天吃饭，而是看监管牌照，美元资金直接从货币市场基金、养老金转移通道来了，比ETF还绕，但合规性更高。

对市场的影响体现在三条传导链：
1. 价格影响：短期BTC $84.7K会受情绪带动，但IBIT持续吸筹意味着这不是炒作，是价值配置。如果这种买法持续一个月，理论上能压平波段的45%震荡幅度。
2. 格局变化：现在监管认可的加密ETF和机构基金成了两条平行的资金管道，美国机构投资者配置加密资产直接跳过交易所，未来可能逼着币安这种交易所把合规业务搬到基金旗下。
3. 历史参考：最像2008年雷曼破产后CDO市场重启，只不过这次是加密市场的"重建基础"。

💡 这次BlackRock的操作是利多，但有个失效条件：如果下周CPI超预期走弱，导致美联储暗示加息，这个判断作废。跌破 $80.5这条逻辑就不成立，毕竟机构资金也怕美联储突然发疯。

The first time I came to the Binance Plaza—let me file a report! A summary of my experience after being in this industry for three months!

Honestly, I’m a total beginner, not some big shot, and I don’t have financial freedom!
I didn’t create this account to do trade signals, and I don’t want to pretend to be some trading genius.
My main goal is to record my real journey starting from zero in the crypto world—including the tuition I paid, my real profits and losses, and my daily learning notes!
If I make money, I’ll post it too; if I lose, it’s fine—I also accept it!
If you’re also a beginner, or if you’ve come through the “beginner grind,” welcome to chat and follow each other, learn together, and slowly get better!
Remember, three months ago when I first got into trading, I was hanging out at a friend’s place, drinking tea and chatting. Every day he’d be staring at his phone, with a bunch of messy red and green numbers on the screen. At the time, I didn’t understand anything, but he could still make a little money on those red-and-green candles every day. He would even invite me to drink with him.

At the time, I was pretty bored and very curious about how he made money. And it was because of this curiosity that I ended up joining this circle. Back then, not knowing anything, I invested 200U and played along with my friend—he would go long, and I would go long too. I copied every step he took.

After the next three days, I’d made about 50U. Thinking, “If it just goes up and you buy, goes down and you sell, you can make money, right?” We had previously been using 50x leverage—my friend helped me set it up. Then I thought, “If it’s that simple and direct, wouldn’t 150x make money faster?” That day I traded on my own, not with my friend. I remember I opened 150x, and the margin was 30U. At that time, the coin I traded was Ethereum—that was also the first coin I ever traded contracts with in the crypto world. I remember the price was around 1780. When I saw it drop quickly from above 1800, I immediately opened a short position. Not long after, I made more than 50U—I closed the position right away!
After finishing that trade, I thought, “Making money with this is way too easy!” Hahaha. And I also felt like I was the genius trader everyone talks about. But… the illusion of being a “pro trader” is usually where it all starts...

When you first entered this space, did you ever get that kind of illusion—“I’m a genius trader”? I’m really curious: when you opened your first trade, did you profit or did you lose?

I’ll keep updating tomorrow—how this “genius trader” like me gets educated by the market and by the influencers afterward.

你们入圈的时候，有没有这种我是天才交易员的错觉？我很好奇你们第一次开单是赚钱的还是亏的？

明天再继续更新 我这种天才交易员后面怎么被市场跟博主教育的。

content:
以太坊市场深度分析：承压震荡，关注支撑有效性

一、价格走势分析

截至北京时间十月三日二十二时，以太坊现货报价二千六百八十点三九美元，过去二十四小时下跌约零点五个百分点。从小时K线来看，以太坊在二千六百八十七美元附近遇阻回落，随后在二千六百七十七至二千六百八十七美元区间内反复震荡，整体呈现弱势整理格局。

以太坊近期的走势受到多重因素压制。现货ETF连续三日录得净流出，分别流出五十五点四百万和一千七百三十万美元，机构端的持续分发对价格形成了明显压制。同时超过八十一万八千枚以太坊处于验证者退出队列，潜在的现货抛售压力不容忽视。

从成交量来看，最近五个一小时周期的成交额分别为七百二十三万、八百二十七万、七百三十八万、六百六十一万和八百七十九万美元。整体成交量维持在相对平稳的水平，没有出现明显的放量或缩量信号，市场处于等待方向选择的状态。

二、技术指标解读

均线系统方面，七小时均线报二千六百八十二点四四美元，二十五小时均线报二千六百七十八点三九美元，九十九小时均线报二千六百九十三点三二美元。值得注意的是，价格目前运行在九十九周期EMA下方，而九十九周期EMA位于二千六百九十二美元附近形成了较强的上方阻力。七周期EMA和二十五周期EMA虽然已经形成金叉，但整体仍受制于长期均线的压制。

MACD指标方面，DIF线为负四点一二，DEA线为负五点七五，柱状图为正一点六三。柱状图连续五个周期保持正值，显示短期下跌动能有所减弱，但DIF和DEA均处于零轴下方，表明中期趋势仍然偏弱。

RSI指标方面，六周期RSI为四十三点零八，十二周期RSI为四十四点二一，二十四周期RSI为四十五点九六。三个周期的RSI均运行在五十下方，显示空头力量仍占主导。短周期RSI从五十九点九的高位快速回落至四十三附近，短期超卖信号初现。

KDJ指标方面，K线为五十四点四六，D线为六十五点七二，J线为三十一点九三。J线快速下行至低位区域，K线与D线形成死叉，短期看空信号较为明确。

布林带显示上轨为二千六百九十点六三美元，中轨为二千六百七十七点七五美元，下轨为二千六百六十四点八六美元。价格在中轨附近运行，带宽有所收窄。AI复合指标给出空头信号，综合得分为零，历史胜率为百分之六十点五三。

三、市场情绪分析

title: Protege tu cartera durante una tendencia bajista.
subTitle:
1. Reduce el riesgo antes de que empeore
- Toma ganancias parciales: si ya tienes beneficios, vende una parte (por ejemplo, el 20-30%) y conviértela a stablecoins (monedas digitales ligadas al dólar, como USDT o USDC) o a dinero fiat (moneda tradicional, como dólares o euros). Así aseguras parte de la ganancia aunque el mercado siga cayendo.
- Reduce el apalancamiento: el apalancamiento es pedir prestado para invertir más de lo que tienes, multiplicando ganancias y pérdidas. En tendencia bajista, una posición apalancada puede liquidarse (forzarte a vender con pérdida total) con una caída pequeña. Bájalo o elimínalo.
- Diversifica fuera del mercado cripto: no tengas el 100% de tus ahorros en criptomonedas. Repartir en otros activos (acciones, bonos, efectivo) reduce el golpe si solo cripto cae.
 2. Usa herramientas de control de pérdidas
- Stop-loss: una orden automática que vende tu cripto si el precio cae a un nivel que definas de antemano. Ejemplo: compraste Bitcoin a $60,000 y pones un stop-loss en $54,000 (10% de caída); si el precio llega ahí, se vende solo, limitando tu pérdida.
- Trailing stop: similar al stop-loss, pero se ajusta automáticamente hacia arriba si el precio sube, protegiendo ganancias sin que tengas que estar pendiente todo el tiempo.
3. Estrategias de acumulación inteligente (si planeas quedarte)
- DCA (Dollar-Cost Averaging / promedio de costo en dólares): en vez de invertir todo de golpe, compra montos fijos pequeños cada semana o mes. Esto evita el error de "comprar todo justo antes de una caída" y suaviza el precio promedio de compra.
- Mantén efectivo o stablecoins listos: tener "pólvora seca" (cash disponible) te permite comprar más barato si el mercado sigue bajando, en vez de vender con pánico.
4. Protege activos con herramientas del propio mercado cripto
- Hedging con derivados (para usuarios más avanzados): abrir una posición corta (apostar a que el precio baja) en futuros para compensar pérdidas de tu cartera principal. Ejemplo: si tienes 1 BTC y temes que baje, puedes abrir un corto equivalente; si BTC cae, pierdes en el spot (tu cripto real) pero ganas en el corto, neutralizando el golpe. Requiere experiencia porque también tiene riesgo.
- Opciones de venta (put options): contratos que te dan el derecho a vender tu cripto a un precio fijo aunque el mercado caiga más. Funcionan como un "seguro" pagando una prima (costo del contrato).
 5. Protege la seguridad física de tus activos
- Mueve fondos a wallets propias (self-custody): en mercados bajistas, algunos exchanges (casas de cambio) quiebran o congelan retiros. Tener tus cripto en una wallet (billetera) que tú controles, no en el exchange, reduce ese riesgo.
- No caigas en pánico por rumores: muchas pérdidas grandes ocurren por vender en el peor momento tras una noticia alarmante sin verificar.
 6. Disciplina psicológica
- Define reglas antes de invertir, no durante la caída: decide con anticipación en qué nivel de pérdida vendes y en cuál compras más. Decidir "en caliente" durante el pánico suele llevar a errores.
- Evita mirar el precio constantemente: revisar el precio cada minuto en una caída aumenta la ansiedad y las decisiones impulsivas.
Espero de corazón esto te ayude. ❤️

📰 Fed Pauses Rate Hikes, but CPI Still High: Is Bitcoin Poised to Keep Falling or Sign a Bottom?

Iran’s central bank plans to crack down on rial accounts linked to crypto exchanges. This will seriously impact local exchange operations and the conversion between the rial and crypto, further intensifying economic isolation. It’s a bearish signal for the global crypto market, but the specific transmission path depends on how funds flow out.

Why is this news important?
This is a typical example of countries outside the world’s major economies tightening crypto regulation. Why does it matter? The root cause is that under U.S. dollar sanctions, Iran wants to use cryptocurrencies to bypass capital controls—but the central bank is pulling the rug out from under that plan. This suggests that the dream of “decentralization” in global crypto can’t stand up to real-world regulatory pressure. In recent other events, we’ve seen the U.S. file a lawsuit against Binance, Germany levy a crypto tax, and now a major Middle Eastern country is joining the crackdown. The industry is entering a full-scale period of regulatory pressure.

Market impact
In the short term, the direct impact on BTC and ETH is limited, but over the long term it is negative. A possible transmission path is: local Iranian funds hit conversion obstacles and flow toward global exchanges; however, the Middle East is one of the most active crypto trading regions globally, so when local capital withdraws, local selling pressure on BTC and ETH increases, putting strain on international markets. For reference, similar historical events: in 2021, when the U.S. prohibited banks from processing crypto transactions, ETH fell 10%. But this time there’s an unusual signal: although the Fed has paused rate hikes, CPI is still high, implying the strong-dollar cycle hasn’t ended—this could reinforce the bearish effect of this news.

Trading idea
💡 If you’re bearish, the support zone is $82K–$83K. That suggests BTC may continue to trade sideways in the $80K–$85K range in the near term. If the Fed subsequently pivots toward rate cuts, this view is invalidated. In short: as long as the dollar doesn’t ease, crypto has a hard time moving independently.

📰 美联储加息暂停但CPI仍高：比特币是继续下跌还是触底信号？

伊朗中央银行计划封杀与加密货币交易所绑定的里亚尔账户，这将严重影响当地交易所运营和土币到币的兑换，加剧经济孤立。对全球加密市场是个利空信号，但具体传导路径要看资金如何外流。

为什么这条新闻重要？
这是全球主要经济体以外的国家加强加密监管的典型案例。为什么重要？根本原因是伊朗在美元制裁下，想用加密货币绕开资本管制，现在被央行釜底抽薪。这意味着全球加密货币的"去中心化"理想在现实监管面前不堪一击。近期其他事件中，我们看到了美国对币安的起诉、德国的加密税，现在中东大国也加入封杀行列，行业进入全面监管高压期。

对市场的影响
短期看，对BTC和ETH的直接影响有限，但长期影响是负面的。传导路径可能是：伊朗本地资金因兑换受阻流向全球交易所，但中东是全球加密交易最活跃市场之一，本土资金抽离→BTC和ETH的本地抛压→国际市场承压。历史类似事件参考，2021年美国禁止银行处理加密交易，当时ETH下跌了10%。但这次有个反常信号：美联储虽然暂停加息但CPI仍高，意味着美元强势周期没有结束，这会强化本新闻的利空效应。

操作思路
💡 如果看跌，支撑位在$82K-$83K区间。这意味着短期内BTC可能继续在80K-$85K区间震荡。如果美联储后续转向降息，这个判断作废。简单说：美元不松口，加密货币想独立很难。

title: 3个指标看懂BTC加BNB的逻辑，别再被一句口号带着走
subTitle:
你是不是也听过“左手比特币，右手BNB”，却不明白为什么另一边不是以太坊？

真正的分歧不在谁的技术更高级，而在于：谁的需求更容易被普通人看见，代币又能不能直接承接这些需求。

$BTC 的角色相对清晰。很多人把它当作加密市场的价值锚，重点关注稀缺性、共识和资金流入。它不靠某个应用爆发，也不需要频繁讲新故事。

$BNB 走的是另一条路。它与交易、链上手续费、生态活动等具体场景联系更紧，同时存在销毁机制。对持有者来说，这些需求比较直观：只要平台和链上生态仍有活跃度，市场就有观察它的理由。

这也是“BTC加BNB”叙事容易传播的原因：一个偏长期价值共识，一个偏平台与生态效用，两者分工明确。

但这不代表 $ETH 没有价值。以太坊仍是智能合约生态的重要基础设施，Layer 2也在延续其开发者和应用优势。只是它的价值路径更复杂：主网费用、代币销毁、增发、质押和Layer 2发展，需要放在一起看。网络活跃度不同时，ETH的净发行状态也会变化，不能简单概括成一直通胀。

BNB同样不是“更便宜，所以一定更好”。它与平台生态联系更深，也意味着要承担平台经营、监管、生态集中度和链上活跃度变化等风险。

所以，别只看创始人的个人魅力，也别只比手续费。判断BNB和ETH，可以盯住三个信号：真实用户是否增长、链上活动是否持续、代币机制能否有效承接生态需求。

行动建议：把BNB和ETH放进同一张观察表，按月记录活跃度、费用与发行变化，再决定是否交易，而不是跟着一句口号下单。本文仅作信息讨论，不构成投资建议。

Under the Securities Act of 1933, the SEC has approved 3x long ETPs for Bitcoin, Ethereum, gold, silver, crude oil, and natural gas. On the surface, it looks like an expansion of tools; in essence, it’s another opening of a traditional capital channel.

In the short term, it will amplify volatility. $BTC  and $ETH  may be easy to chase higher on sentiment. But 3x products are a double-edged sword—drawdowns are magnified as well, and in choppy markets the “grind” effect is especially noticeable.

Over the medium term, putting crypto alongside gold, silver, crude oil, and natural gas in the same batch of approvals suggests regulators are bringing both types of assets into the leveraged allocation framework together. Bottom line: this isn’t a mindless bullish signal—it’s a sign that liquidity and volatility tools are in place.

$ETH  The contract only loses 50 USDT each time, and the risk share will keep increasing. 

Suppose the account has 1,000 USDT, and the loss budget per trade is fixed at 50. Initially, this is equivalent to 5% of the principal.

If the first 4 consecutive actual losses are exactly 50 each time, and there are no other gains or losses, the principal left becomes 800. In the next trade, it still takes the loss budget of 50, but the share has become 6.25%.

With the amount unchanged, the proportion of principal being risked is 25% higher than at the beginning. So, “losing the same amount each time” and “taking the same percentage risk each time” are two different setups.

If you want the budget to always be 5% of the remaining principal, then with an 800 principal, the corresponding amount is 40—not 50. This ratio is only a calculation assumption and does not represent a risk level suitable for everyone.

Also note: a budget of 50 does not mean that after execution the loss will definitely be only 50. Slippage and fees may cause the loss to exceed the preset amount.

The above is a risk-control example for Binance ETH/USDT perpetual contracts; it is not a real trade record. As of 20:57 (Beijing time) on October 3, it does not include fees or other gains/losses.

截至二零二六年十月三日，以太坊当前报价二千六百八十五美元，过去二十四小时下跌约百分之二点六。从小时K线来看，最近五根K线在二千六百七十八美元至二千六百八十八美元之间窄幅波动，振幅仅约十美元，显示市场处于极度缩量的横盘整理状态。成交量从高峰的一千一百四十九万美元逐步萎缩至五百二十一万美元，多空双方均缺乏主动进攻的意愿。

均线系统呈现空头排列格局。七日均线二千六百八十二美元略低于当前价格，二十五日均线二千六百八十五美元与当前价格持平，而九十九日均线二千六百九十五美元则明显高于当前价格，形成上方压制。七指数移动均线二千六百八十二美元与二十五指数移动均线二千六百八十七美元同样紧贴当前价格，短期方向不明。值得注意的是，超级趋势线指标位于二千七百一十二美元，远高于当前价格，确认中期趋势仍偏空。

二、技术指标解读

MACD指标显示，MACD线为负五点二一，信号线为负七点一二，柱状图为正一点九，柱状图连续四个周期为正且维持在一点九附近，表明虽然整体仍处于空头区域，但下跌动能已明显减弱，有筑底迹象。RSI六周期指标回落至五十，RSI十二周期为四十五点七，RSI二十四周期为四十六点五，均处于中性偏弱区域，尚未进入超卖，说明空头仍有一定空间。

KDJ指标中K值七十二点三，D值七十三点九，J值六十九点一，三线在高位出现死叉迹象，短线面临回调压力。布林带上轨二千六百九十一点，中轨二千六百七十六美元，下轨二千六百六十二美元，带宽约三十美元，价格在中轨上方运行，短期有向中轨回归的倾向。ATR十四周期为十一点一，波动率极低，暗示市场正在酝酿新的行情。威廉指标负二十六点八，处于中性区域。

三、市场情绪分析

以太坊当前面临多重压力。首先，美国非农就业数据大幅不及预期引发市场对经济衰退的担忧，风险资产普遍承压，以太坊作为高贝塔资产跌幅更大。其次，现货市场出现大规模资金外流，连续数小时净流出超过两亿四千万美元，以大单卖出为主，显示机构和大户正在减仓。以太坊现货ETF也持续遭遇赎回，单日净流出分别达到五千五百四十万美元和一千七百三十万美元，机构需求明显降温。

链上数据方面，验证者退出队列已达到约八十五万枚以太坊，等待时间约十五天，这一大规模的解质押潮可能带来潜在的现货抛压。此外，以太坊二层网络Blast宣布关闭，其运营收入已无法覆盖成本，最后二十四小时仅产生一百一十美元的链上费用，BLAST代币暴跌超过百分之四十，这一事件反映出整个以太坊二层生态面临盈利困境，对市场信心造成一定打击。不过，美国证券交易委员会批准了三倍杠杆比特币和以太坊ETP产品，长期来看有利于吸引更多机构资金进入以太坊生态。

The Ethereum validator exit queue has climbed to approximately **773,447 ETH**.

That is the highest level recorded in 2026.

The estimated waiting time has also increased to nearly **two weeks**.

This means a large number of validators are trying to exit Ethereum staking at the same time.

Why does this matter?

A rising exit queue can signal:

• Reduced confidence among stakers  
• Increased demand for liquidity  
• Possible profit-taking  
• Future ETH supply becoming available  
• Short-term pressure on market sentiment  

But there is an important distinction:

ETH in the exit queue is not the same as ETH being sold immediately.

Ethereum’s protocol limits how quickly validators can exit, which spreads withdrawals over time.

The key question is what happens next.

If new staking deposits remain strong, the exit queue may eventually normalize.

If exits continue rising while entry demand weakens, more ETH could gradually return to liquid markets.

That could create additional selling pressure.

Watch these metrics closely:

ETH exit queue  
ETH entry queue  
Staking participation  
Exchange balances  
ETH/BTC ratio  
Ethereum ETF flows  
Validator activity  

The exit queue is not an automatic sell signal.

But a sudden increase in unstaking demand is a clear sentiment warning.

Ethereum’s next major move may depend on whether new stakers absorb the exits—or whether more supply reaches the market.

SEC Unveils Major Move: Crypto Asset Custody Rules See a Significant Turning Point!

The U.S. SEC has officially proposed amendments to crypto asset custody rules, aiming to establish a clearer custody framework for investment advisers and regulated funds. The proposal also considers allowing limited self-custody under certain conditions, and includes state-chartered trust companies within the scope of eligible custodial institutions. (Securities and Exchange Commission)

What does this mean?

Potentially Lower Entry Barriers for Institutions
In the past, crypto asset custody faced numerous compliance hurdles, and the new rules are expected to provide a more defined compliance path.

Self-Custody Recognized by Regulators
The SEC is not simply banning it—it is considering allowing institutions to engage in self-custody under strict conditions and risk controls.

Further Integration of Traditional Finance and the Crypto Market
If the rules are ultimately implemented, the space for funds, investment advisers, and custodians to participate in the crypto market may expand even further.

More importantly: this is still only a proposal, not the final rule. After official release, it will enter a 60-day public comment period. (Securities and Exchange Commission)

My Take:
The signal the SEC has sent this time is very clear—the U.S. regulatory approach to the crypto market is gradually shifting from “restriction and enforcement” to “establishing rules and enabling institutional compliance.”

If the custody rules truly take effect, the infrastructure for institutional capital to enter the crypto market could reach another level.

Do you think this is a big positive for mainstream assets like BTC and ETH?

title: ⚖️ Futures Grid Neutral: Cómo monetizar la volatilidad y las Tasas de Financiación sin sesgo direcci
subTitle:
Operar en mercados de futuros no requiere adivinar la dirección del precio. Para el trader cuantitativo, el objetivo no es predecir si Bitcoin subirá o bajará mañana, sino capitalizar el flujo de órdenes y la volatilidad dentro de un rango determinado.

El Futures Grid Neutral (Grilla Neutra de Futuros) en Binance combina posiciones long y short automáticas dentro de una misma estructura, permitiéndote generar ganancias en ambas direcciones mientras recolectas Grid Profits y aprovechas las divergencias en las tasas de financiación.

1. La Estructura del Futures Grid Neutral

A diferencia de una grilla direccional (Long o Short pura):

Punto Medio Dinámico: El bot inicia sin exposición abierta (Delta Zero). Al subir el precio, ejecuta ventas en corto (Shorts) para capturar el retroceso; al bajar, ejecuta compras en largo (Longs) para capturar el rebote.

Captura Doble de Volatilidad: Monetiza las oscilaciones en ambas direcciones dentro del rango definido, multiplicando la frecuencia de ejecución por hora frente a un bot tradicional.

2. El Beneficio Oculto: Arbitraje Pasivo por Funding Rate

Flujo de Caja Adicional: En mercados alcistas donde la Tasa de Financiación (Funding Rate) es altamente positiva, sostener posiciones Short ejecutadas por el bot permite cobrar comisiones periódicas cada 8 horas abonadas directamente a tu margen.

Mitigación del Sesgo Emocional: Al no depender de una tendencia clara, se elimina el estrés operando en zonas de consolidación o incertidumbre macroeconómica.

3. Consejo Táctico Express (Regla del Margen Aislado)

💡 El "Tip" Neutral: Configura siempre tu Futures Grid Neutral utilizando Margen Aislado (Isolated Margin) y un apalancamiento conservador entre 2x y 5x. Mantener el apalancamiento bajo garantiza que el precio de liquidación de las posiciones extremas quede muy fuera del rango operativo, permitiendo que el bot absorba expansiones breves de volatilidad sin poner en riesgo la totalidad de tu cuenta.

👉 ¿Prefieres operar futuros de forma direccional o utilizas grillas neutras para reducir el riesgo de mercado? ¡Déjame tu estrategia en los comentarios!

Si este análisis cuantitativo te ayuda a profesionalizar tu operativa automatizada en Binance, sígueme para continuar descubriendo más herramientas tácticas.

Visa’s latest earnings report shows that in fiscal year 2026 to date, about 17% of transactions in its credit card business linked to stablecoins come from the enterprise payments sector. Visa currently supports more than 160 stablecoin card programs, covering both consumer spending and business payments. This data indicates that stablecoins are penetrating from personal spending cards into areas such as business cash management and cross-border settlement—gradually shedding their “crypto toy” image.

Why is this news important?
Visa is the absolute leader in global enterprise payments. Its shift in focus for stablecoin card business toward the B2B segment suggests that crypto technology is starting to be accepted in mainstream commercial scenarios. Why does that matter? The core reason is compliance demand in business payments. Over the past two years, regulators have increasingly viewed cryptocurrencies as moving from high-risk speculative products toward practical tools. Scenarios like supply-chain finance—something banks were previously reluctant to do but where stablecoins can solve settlement-efficiency issues—are being tested by enterprise payment systems. This reflects stablecoin ecosystem maturity more than just looking at personal user transaction volumes—stablecoins are being written into companies’ “five-year plans” rather than “monthly experiment reports.”

Market impact
What does this mean for BTC and ETH?
In the short term, it can boost market confidence in the value of stablecoin assets. But more importantly, it reveals a possible new direction for capital flows: once enterprise-level applications scale up, they will create substantial demand for stablecoin liquidity. For example, in international trade, USD stablecoins can help firms avoid exchange-rate fluctuations and high fees from traditional banks, reducing procurement costs by 1%-5%. This business logic could drive more real capital to allocate into stablecoin assets. Quant’s blockchain token QNT has already launched into the Solana ecosystem through Sunrise infrastructure and the Raydium DEX. This isn’t Quant giving up on Ethereum; it’s simply a straightforward expansion of cross-chain markets. Solana users can now easily participate in QNT’s liquidity, but QNT’s core ecosystem still remains on Ethereum. In other words, this is Quant adding a liquidity “entry ramp” on Solana, bringing this long-established interoperability token into Solana’s DeFi channel.

Why is this news important?
Quant has always been pushing interoperability between blockchains. This time, choosing Solana as the bridge likely has several deeper reasons. First, Solana’s high performance and low costs are attractive for interoperability projects that require frequent, high-speed interactions. Second, Quant’s strategy may be to take advantage of Solana’s rapid growth, without intending to abandon Ethereum as its foundation. Ethereum’s ecosystem is currently more mature, especially in the DeFi space. This means Quant’s cross-chain strategy is defensive rather than offensive. It enhances resilience against risk, but it doesn’t necessarily mean shifting positions.

Market impact
From a market perspective, this news doesn’t directly provide any catalyst for BTC or ETH prices. But it suggests that cross-chain cooperation is a future trend, which may encourage other projects to pursue similar cross-chain expansions. On the regulatory front, if regulators see that a project has compliant liquidity arrangements across multiple chains, they may be more inclined to approve its compliance pathway. In terms of capital flows, this could draw some users who were previously active only within the Solana ecosystem to pay attention to QNT. In history, similar events include interoperability protocol expansions by Polkadot and Cosmos—though that time it was mainly technology-driven. This time, Quant is also adding commercial considerations.

Trading idea
💡 I believe this move by Quant is neutral, with no obvious short-term impact on the QNT price. 以太坊市场深度分析：区间震荡中的结构性机会与风险提示

一、价格走势回顾

截至二零二六年十月三日晚间，以太坊现货报价二千六百八十二美元，过去二十四小时内上涨约百分之零点六五。从小时级别K线来看，以太坊在二千六百七十九至二千六百九十美元的狭窄区间内运行，整体波动幅度极为有限。日内高点为二千六百九十美元，低点为二千六百七十九美元，振幅不足十美元，显示市场处于极度缩量整理状态。

近期以太坊受到多重消息面影响。一方面，美国证券交易委员会批准了三倍杠杆以太坊ETP产品，为机构投资者提供了更丰富的风险敞口工具，长期来看有利于吸引更多机构资金流入。另一方面，曾经的头部以太坊二层网络Blast宣布关闭，其锁仓量从峰值的二十二亿美元暴跌百分之九十八，月度收入仅有一百一十美元，远低于运营成本。这一事件引发了市场对小型二层网络经济可持续性的广泛讨论。

二、技术指标解读

均线系统方面，七小时均线报二千六百八十五美元，二十五小时均线报二千六百七十九美元，九十九小时均线报二千六百九十三美元。当前价格位于短期均线上方但低于九十九小时均线，表明短期走势偏强但中期仍受到压制。价格需要有效突破二千六百九十三美元的长期均线压力才能打开进一步上行空间。

布林带指标显示上轨位于二千六百八十九美元，中轨位于二千六百八十二美元，下轨位于二千六百七十六美元。布林带开口持续收窄，价格运行在中轨附近，暗示变盘行情即将到来。带宽收窄到极致后往往伴随大幅波动，投资者需要做好双向准备。

MACD指标方面，DIF线为负一点七五，DEA线为负三点五一，柱状图为正一点七六。MACD柱状图连续多个周期保持正值，显示多头动能正在缓慢积累。DIF线持续向零轴靠拢，若能在未来数小时内完成金叉并突破零轴，将确认短期多头趋势的建立。

RSI指标显示六周期RSI为六十一点八一，十二周期RSI为五十二点四四，二十四周期RSI为四十八点八九。短周期RSI率先走强进入偏多区域，但中长周期RSI仍在五十附近徘徊，表明市场整体动能尚未完全转强。

KDJ指标中K线为六十九点零二，D线为六十六点零八，J线为七十四点九零。KDJ三线向上发散，短期多头动能正在增强。威廉指标报负二十二点四零，处于偏强区域但未进入超买，仍有上行余地。

综合指标来看，AI复合信号显示多头占比百分之五十三点三，空头占比百分之四十，综合指标值为零，发出偏空信号。这与技术指标的多头信号形成矛盾，反映出市场方向的不确定性较高。历史胜率显示空头信号的整体胜率为百分之六十点五三，提示投资者需要警惕下行风险。

三、市场情绪分析

以太坊市场当前面临多空因素交织的复杂局面。利好方面，三倍杠杆ETP的获批为以太坊打开了新的机构入场通道，大额订单净流入超过两千两百万美元，鲸鱼买盘在关键价位提供了有效支撑。

利空方面，以太坊ETF持续遭遇赎回，累计流出规模超过一亿美元，形成了结构性的现货抛压。Blast二层的关闭不仅打击了市场信心，也暴露了当前二层网络过度依赖空投激励而缺乏真实收入来源的根本问题。技术面上，以太坊运行在EMA九9二千六百九十二美元和布林中轨下方，上行空间受到明显压制。

从链上数据来看，OBV指标维持在四十四万七千以上的高位，显示成交量整体偏向积累。但ATR指标降至八点五四，波动率持续走低，预示着市场即将迎来方向选择。综合来看，以太坊短期需要关注二千六百九十美元阻力的突破情况。若能有效站稳该位置，上方目标看向二千七百五十美元。若突破失败，下方二千六百七十美元将是重要支撑位。建议投资者在方向明确前保持谨慎，控制仓位，等待更明确的信号出现。

Last Friday, BitMine Immersion held more than 6 million ETH, accounting for about 4.8% of the circulating supply. Meanwhile, its stock price was $16 billion—nearly equal to its market value. This institution continues to add this week, and it may break the 5% threshold next month. Why is this news important?
BitMine’s ETH holdings rising from 4% to 5% isn’t just a number change; it marks a turning point in institutional fund behavior. Historically, before large capital increases reach this threshold, the market is usually hesitant. But once it crosses, other capital often follows. The special thing here is that BitMine’s holdings have already exceeded $16 billion—large enough to affect parts of supply and demand. At the same time, the 4.8% figure is close to the average growth pace of institutional ETH holdings of all holders above $5 billion over the past three years.

Impact on the market
In the short term, BTC and ETH prices won’t jump directly, because this behavior is happening against the backdrop of central banks staying hawkish worldwide and whales net-selling ETH. But it implies:
1. Some market sentiment has shifted toward the bottom area; at least in the 4.8%-5% range, there is a cushion
2. Institutional behavior is moving from diversified investing toward thematic investing, which may accelerate ETH inflows into specific tracks
3. This datapoint of 4.8% is more meaningful than simply “60,000 ETH” (equivalent to potential value fluctuations of about 2 million ETH)

📰 为什么 BitMine 买 ETH 买到 6 万枚，市场还没反应过来？

BitMine Immersion 上周五持仓超过 600 万枚 ETH，占流通总量约 4.8%，同时股价 160 亿美元，几乎和市值持平。这家机构本周继续增持，可能下月破 5% 阈值。目前市场对此没有明显表现，但这家公司已连续 5 周净购 ETH，意味着什么？

为什么这条新闻重要？
BitMine 的 ETH 持仓从 4% 升至 5% 不仅是数字变化，而是机构资金行为的拐点。历史上，大资金增持到这个阈值前，市场总在犹豫，但一旦突破，往往会触发其他资金跟随。这次特殊性在于 BitMine 持仓已超 $160 亿，体量足够改变部分供需关系。同时，4.8% 的比例已接近过去 3 年所有 50 亿美元以上 ETH 机构持仓的平均增长速率。

对市场的影响
短期内 BTC 和 ETH 价格不会有直接跳涨，因为该行为发生在全球央行持续鹰派、鲸鱼净卖 ETH 的背景下。但意味着：
1. 某部分市场情绪已转向底部区域，至少在 4.8%-5% 这个区间是安全垫
2. 机构行为从分散投资转向主题投资，可能加速 ETH 流入特定赛道
3. 4.8% 这个数据点比单纯的 6 万枚更有参考价值（相当于约 200 万枚 ETH 的潜在价值波动）

一句话翻译：钱没有离开市场，但正悄悄在某个角落筑底。

操作思路
💡 如果 BTC 守住 $119.98K、ETH 维持在 $2.6K 以上，这个 5% 阈值可能成为支撑位。但一旦这两个价位失守，BitMine 的 ETH 增持可能被解读为防御性布局而非进攻信号，判断作废。

【判断附带失效条件】如果 BTC 跌破 $82K 或 ETH 低于 $2.5K，这个判断作废。

translatedData.content: Another story of falling before dawn. Someone went long in the period from June to August last year at an average price of $3,040, accumulating 6,500 ETH. At its worst, the unrealized loss exceeded $9.55 million, and they held on for a full year. But today they deposited 6,595 ETH—about $17.57 million—into an exchange and cut their losses, shrinking their assets by 12.3%, for a real loss of $2.44 million. They once didn’t run even with a paper loss of ten million, yet they did run when down a little over two million. This is the hardest hurdle in trading: you can stomach losses, but you can’t hold on to get back to even. Position management is always more important than timing. #ETH

Ethereum Market In-Depth Analysis: Bounce Momentum Begins to Emerge; Key Resistance Levels Await Breakthrough

I. Review of Price Trend

As of the early hours of October 4 (Beijing time), Ethereum is quoted at $2,684. Over the past 24 hours, it has risen by about 0.9%. The price rebounded from an intraday low of $2,678 to around $2,690, and then pulled back slightly to the current level. Overall, Ethereum has been trading in an extremely narrow range of $2,680 to $2,690, with noticeably less fluctuation than Bitcoin—indicating the market is in an accumulation phase before directional selection.

In terms of trading volume, the total trading value in the most recent hour is about $15.57 million, down compared to the previous hour. Looking back over the past five hours, during the move from $2,681 to $2,689, trading volume increased significantly, suggesting that funds were actively participating in the rebound. However, then volume quickly shrank to $4.86 million, reflecting insufficient chasing demand.

II. Interpretation of Technical Indicators

For the moving average system, the 7-period moving average is $2,683.66, slightly above the 25-period moving average at $2,677.8. Short-term moving averages show a weak bullish alignment. However, the 99-period moving average at $2,692.77 is still above the current price, forming an important short-term resistance level. The price needs to break through $2,692 effectively to confirm that the short-term trend turns bullish.

The MACD indicator shows that the histogram has stayed positive for five consecutive periods. The latest reading is approximately 1.84. The MACD line has risen from -4.27 to -2.55, and the signal line is also moving upward in sync. Although the MACD line remains below the zero axis, the histogram staying positive and maintaining an expanding trend suggests that short-term bullish momentum is gradually building. That said, the expansion speed of the histogram has slowed somewhat, so the possibility of momentum weakening should be watched.

The RSI indicator shows a 6-period RSI of 55.16, a 12-period RSI of 49.76, and a 24-period RSI of 47.97. Previously, the 6-period RSI surged as high as 71.28, then quickly fell back to around 55, indicating that short-term overbought pressure has already been released. Currently, all three RSI lines are in the neutral zone, suggesting the market is temporarily balanced between bulls and bears.

In the KDJ indicator, the K value is 64.71, the D value is 64.42, and the J value is 65.29. The three lines are clustered in the mid-range, with unclear directional bias. For the Bollinger Bands, the price is trading between the midline at $2,680 and the upper band at $2,689. The band width is relatively narrow, implying an upcoming directional breakout.

III. Market Sentiment Analysis

According to factor statistics, among 15 factors, 8 issue long (bullish) signals, 6 issue short (bearish) signals, and 1 is neutral. Overall, the long factors have a slight numerical advantage. However, the composite signals from the indicators are bearish, with a win rate of about 60.53%. This suggests that under the current market conditions, bearish signals have higher historical reliability, so investors need to remain cautious.

From a capital flow perspective, there has been a recent large net inflow of about $11.1 million, and large-order trading accounts for more than 54%. The involvement of “whale” funds is an important force driving Ethereum’s rebound. However, based on ETF data, spot Ethereum ETFs have recorded net outflows for four consecutive days, and weekly redemption size exceeds $100 million. Institutional capital appears relatively cautious in the spot segment, which conflicts with the large on-chain buying.

At the industry level, Ethereum’s ecosystem is undergoing structural adjustment. Layer2 network Blast shut down operations due to operating costs far exceeding revenue. Its locked amount plunged from a peak of $2.27 billion to about $320 million, a drop of as much as 98%. This event highlights the fragility of an “airdrop incentive” model, but it also encourages capital to return to Ethereum’s mainnet, which in the long run may benefit the healthy development of the mainnet ecosystem.

In terms of regulation, a triple-leveraged Ethereum exchange-traded product received approval from the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, providing institutional investors with a richer set of trading tools. At the same time, the SEC proposed new custodial framework rules for crypto assets, aimed at clarifying how registered investment advisers can legally hold clients’ crypto assets. As the regulatory environment becomes progressively clearer, it will likely help attract more traditional financial capital.

In summary, Ethereum is currently near a key technical area. The 99-period moving average at $2,692 and the Bollinger Bands upper band at $2,689 form a double resistance. Meanwhile, the 25-period moving average at $2,677 provides short-term support. Investors are advised to closely monitor whether the price can effectively break through the resistance zone above, and also to track changes in ETF capital flows as well as further evolution in the macro environment.

以太坊市场深度分析：反弹动能初现，关键阻力位待突破

一、价格走势回顾

截至北京时间十月四日凌晨，以太坊报价两千六百八十四美元，过去二十四小时上涨约百分之零点九。价格从两千六百七十八美元的日内低点反弹至两千六百九十美元附近，随后小幅回落至当前水平。整体来看，以太坊在两千六百八十至两千六百九十的极窄区间内运行，波动幅度明显小于比特币，显示市场处于方向选择前的蓄势阶段。

从成交量来看，最近一个小时的成交额约为一千五百五十七万美元，较前一小时有所下降。回顾过去五个小时的成交数据，在价格从两千六百八十一美元上涨至两千六百八十九美元的过程中，成交量出现了明显放大，说明反弹过程中有资金积极参与。但随后量能快速萎缩至四百八十六万美元，反映追涨意愿不足。

二、技术指标解读

均线系统方面，七周期均线两千六百八十三点六六美元略高于二十五周期均线两千六百七十七点八美元，短期均线呈现微弱的多头排列。但九十九周期均线两千六百九十二点七七美元仍位于当前价格上方，构成重要的短期阻力。价格需要有效突破两千六百九十二美元才能确认短期趋势转多。

MACD指标显示，柱状图已连续五个周期保持正值，最新读数约为一点八四，MACD线从负四点二七回升至负二点五五，信号线也在同步上行。虽然MACD线仍处于零轴下方，但柱状图持续为正且保持扩张态势，表明短期多头动能正在逐步积累。不过柱状图的扩张速度有所放缓，需警惕动能衰减的可能。

RSI指标显示六周期RSI为五十五点一六，十二周期RSR为四十九点七六，二十四周期RSI为四十七点九七。此前六周期RSI一度冲高至七十一点二八，随后快速回落至五十五附近，显示短期超买压力已经释放。目前三条RSI线均处于中性区域，表明市场暂时处于多空均衡状态。

KDJ指标中K值为六十四点七一，D值为六十四点四二，J值为六十五点二九，三线粘合于中位区域，方向性不明确。布林带方面，价格运行在中轨两千六百八十美元与上轨两千六百八十九美元之间，带宽较窄，暗示即将迎来方向性突破。

三、市场情绪分析

从因子统计来看，十五个因子中有八个发出做多信号，六个发出做空信号，一个中性，多头因子数量略占优势。但综合指标给出的信号为做空，胜率约为百分之六十点五三，说明在当前市场环境下空头信号的历史可靠性更高，投资者需要保持警惕。

从资金面来看，近期出现了大额净流入约一千一百一十万美元，大单成交量占比超过百分之五十四，鲸鱼资金的介入是推动以太坊反弹的重要力量。然而从ETF数据来看，现货以太坊ETF连续四天净流出，周度赎回规模超过一亿美元，机构资金在现货层面的态度相对谨慎，与链上大额买入形成矛盾信号。

行业层面，以太坊生态正经历结构性调整。Layer2网络Blast因运营成本远超收入宣布关闭，其锁仓量从峰值的二十二点七亿美元暴跌至约三千二百万美元，跌幅高达百分之九十八。这一事件暴露了空投激励模式的脆弱性，但也促使资金回流以太坊主网，长期来看可能有利于主网生态的健康发展。

监管方面，三倍杠杆以太坊交易所交易产品获得美国证券交易委员会批准，为机构投资者提供了更丰富的交易工具。同时SEC提出了加密资产托管框架新规，旨在明确注册投资顾问如何合法持有客户加密资产，监管环境的逐步清晰化有利于吸引更多传统金融资本入场。

综合来看，以太坊当前处于关键技术位附近，上方两千六百九十二美元的九十九周期均线和两千六百八十九美元的布林带上轨构成双重阻力，下方两千六百七十七美元的二十五周期均线提供短期支撑。建议投资者密切关注价格能否有效突破上方阻力区域，同时关注ETF资金流向的变化以及宏观环境的进一步演变。

热门代币播报

GLMR，现价零点零一三六七二美元，二十四小时涨幅百分之六十一点一九，宣布迁移至Base并转型AI代理结算层，引发市场强烈关注。

QI，现价零点零零三一九四美元，二十四小时涨幅百分之二十六点八五，交易量显著放大，短期动能强劲。

ONE，现价零点零零二五七八美元，二十四小时涨幅百分之二十两点七六，成交额达一千八百二十二万美元，市场热度持续攀升。

translatedData.content: Over the past two days, BTC and ETH ETFs have seen synchronized net outflows. Everyone’s asking whether institutions have run. Here’s something many people don’t know: in that earlier streak of nine consecutive days of net inflows, a large amount of money simply didn’t care about price moving up or down—it was arbitrage capital. They buy spot ETF on the left hand, and short futures on the right hand, locking both sides to profit from the basis. Now the basis has narrowed and there’s no “meat” left. This group settles up and leaves the stage, and a big portion of the ETF outflows is them exiting. So don’t panic: one day of outflows means they’re stepping away, but only after three consecutive days is it truly a withdrawal. For ETH, it falling first is also normal—the money that’s exiting always sells what has more elasticity first. #BTC #ETH #ETF
